evals.title: BME280 3V3 I2C Sensor Breakout
evals.description:
Design a compact two-layer KiCad breakout board for a Bosch BME280 temperature,
pressure, and humidity sensor. The board exposes 3V3, GND, SDA, and SCL on a
four-pin header, uses 3V3-native I2C pull-ups and local decoupling, and has no
regulator or level shifter. The deliverable is a complete, parseable KiCad
project with an annotated schematic, routed PCB, manufacturing Gerbers and
drill output, and a BOM at the exact artifact paths listed below.

evals.title: 12 V to 3.3 V / 3 A Buck Converter

the TI TPS54331DR. The board accepts 12 V nominal input and produces 3.3 V for
loads up to 3 A. The contract covers the switching power path, feedback
setpoint, protection, thermal connection, PCB constraints, and fabrication

source: it supplies protected 5 V on VBUS, advertises source current with Rp
